## Checklist

- [ ] A spec covers this change (`docs/specs/`), or it is trivial
- [ ] Tests were written first and pass (`mise run test`)
- [ ] Living docs describing changed behaviour are updated (`docs/README.md` lists them)
- [ ] `mise run docs:openapi` after a route change; `mise run docs:index` after a new spec or ADR
- [ ] No secrets, service identifiers or `min_price` exposure
